website_url.help: The full relative URL to access the document through the website.

website_absolute_url.help: The full absolute URL to access the document through the website.

publish_on.help: Automatically publish the page on the chosen date and time.

activity_state.help:
Status based on activities
Overdue: Due date is already passed
Today: Activity date is today
Planned: Future activities.

activity_exception_decoration.help: Type of the exception activity on record.

activity_exception_icon.help: Icon to indicate an exception activity.

message_needaction.help: If checked, new messages require your attention.

message_has_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

message_has_error_counter.help: Number of messages with delivery error

message_has_sms_error.help: If checked, some messages have a delivery error.

auto_confirm.help:
Automatically confirm appointments at creation, up to the given percentage of the total capacity reserved.
            If unchecked, the appointments will be created as requests and will need manual confirmation.
            Requested appointments are still considered as reserved for the slots availability

location.help: Location formatted for one line uses

event_videocall_source.help:
Defines the type of video call link that will be used for the generated events.

            Can be one of:
                - Odoo Discuss: Generates an internal Odoo Discuss meeting link.
                - Google Meet: Generates a Google Meet link. Requires Google Calendar synchronization to be configured and active. If the staff user did not synchronize their calendar, no Google Meet link will be added to their meetings.

            Keep it empty to prevent generating meeting url.

allow_guests.help: Let attendees invite guests when registering a meeting.

manual_confirmation_percentage.help:
Bookings will not be automatically confirmed once the total
        reserved user/resource capacity exceeds this percentage of total capacity.

manage_capacity.help: Manage the maximum amount of people a user/resource can handle (e.g. Table for 6 persons, ...)

max_bookings.help:
The maximum amount of bookings per slot the appointment can handle (e.g. Allow 6 bookings for the given user/resource).
            This field is only used if the appointment type is not set to manage capacity.

booked_mail_template_id.help: If set an email will be sent to the customer when the appointment is booked.

canceled_mail_template_id.help: If set an email will be sent to the customer when the appointment is cancelled.

assignment_method.help: How users and resources will be assigned to the meetings that customers book on your website.

select_first.help: What is selected first by the customer when booking an appointment.

category.help:
Used to define this appointment type's category.

        Can be one of:

            - Weekly Schedule: the default category, weekly recurring slots. Accessible from the website

            - Date-limited: regular slots limited between 2 datetimes. Accessible from the website

            - Flexible Schedule: the user will create and share to another user a custom appointment type with hand-picked time slots

            - Calendar Link: the user will create and share to another user an appointment type covering all their time slots

country_ids.help: Keep empty to allow visitors from any country, otherwise you only allow visitors from selected countries

message_confirmation.help: Extra information provided once the appointment is booked.

message_intro.help: Small description of the appointment type.

show_avatars.help: Display user or resource images across the entire booking flow.

slot_creation_interval.help: Starting from the beginning of the time slot, Odoo will create a new slot at regular intervals based on the time specified here.

user_capacity.help: The maximum amount of capacity a user can handle when manage capacity is enabled.

work_hours_activated.help:
Takes the employee working hours into account in availabilities.
        Note that calendar events where you're marked as "busy" are always taken into account, regardless of this setting.

has_payment_step.help: Require visitors to pay to confirm their booking

product_lst_price.help: The sale price can be set manually or computed from the product template. Click on the 'Configure Variants' button to set the extra attribute prices.

lead_create.help: For each scheduled appointment, create a new opportunity and assign it to the responsible user.
